context: Tests whether the agent folds scanning into the existing verify job on pushes, relies on free push protection for public repositories and Gitleaks for private ones, drops redundant triggers and scanners, and keeps verify as the only required check without stranding open pull requests.

checklist.name: Scan inside verify
checklist.description: Runs the scan as steps of the existing verify job instead of a separate scan job, citing GitHub's per-job rounding up to a whole minute

checklist.name: Push-time only
checklist.description: Scans pushes to the default branch (the pushed range) and manual dispatch; drops the pull_request trigger because merges land as pushes, and the scan step cannot fail a pull-request run

checklist.name: No scheduled scan
checklist.description: Removes the weekly schedule, naming Dependabot alerts and Renovate as the channel for new advisories, and keeps manual full-history dispatch

checklist.name: Public relies on push protection
checklist.description: Keeps free GitHub secret scanning and push protection on public repositories and skips Gitleaks on their ordinary pushes

checklist.name: Private uses Gitleaks
checklist.description: Runs the Gitleaks CLI on private repositories and states that paid Secret Protection is priced per active committer; does not use gitleaks-action without addressing its organization license

checklist.name: TruffleHog dropped
checklist.description: Removes the duplicate TruffleHog full-history scan, or justifies keeping it with a named gap Gitleaks and GitHub scanning leave

checklist.name: Workflow linters gated
checklist.description: Runs actionlint and zizmor only when the pushed range changes workflows, action metadata, or their configuration, and always on manual dispatch

checklist.name: One required check
checklist.description: Requires only verify, justified by Renovate auto-merge, keeps the administrator bypass for direct pushes, and removes the extra scan-named contexts

checklist.name: No stranded pull requests
checklist.description: Updates rulesets for removed or renamed checks and confirms no open pull request is left waiting on an old check name

checklist.name: Minute arithmetic
checklist.description: Estimates weekly minutes before and after from push, pull-request, and schedule counts with whole-minute rounding, and names the remaining cost

checklist.name: Constraints honored
checklist.description: Adds no local git hooks, no new notification channel, and no new job or schedule without a named threat and cost
